seen.extent: c. 9r clear Spanish text; c. 10r about 22 lines of cipher (signs plus syllabic groups such as lab, leb, den, gos, pre, ral) from the fifth line down; c. 11r about 14 lines of cipher in two blocks, then 'De Genoua a vij de março M.D.xxvij' and the signature; cc. 9v, 10v, 11v, 12r/v carry no further cipher
seen.cipher: Spanish letter, signed Genoa 7 March 1527, partly in cipher: a mixed system of single signs (loops, crosses, 4, L, 11, 3) and three-letter syllabic groups (lab, leb, den, gos). The cipher stretches are written in the running text with no interlinear or marginal plaintext, and no separate clear copy or decipherment is filed with the four leaves (cc. 9-12); the blank leaves carry only the address and a later hand 'Lope de Soria'.

prior_art.decode: known.py (harvested DECODE dump, repo ledgers) on 'Soria Lannoy': hits only catalogue entries for Charles V to Soria 1523/1524 and the repo targets soria1523 and soria1527; no record for this Lannoy letter or for the Autografoteca Campori in DECODE.
prior_art.tomokiyo: Tomokiyo cryptiana habsburg.htm (fetched 3 Nov 2026) mentions Soria only as the recipient of Charles V's 'complicated Spanish-style cipher'; unsolved.htm has no Soria, Lannoy or Genoa 1527 item; no page reads this letter.
prior_art.lasry: Lasry's papers and GL.htm: web search 'Lope de Soria cipher Charles V Genoa 1527 decipherment Lasry' found only the Pierrot/Loria Charles V 1547 Saint-Mauris letter, nothing on Soria to Lannoy; repo GL.htm copies have no hit.
prior_art.edition: Calendar of State Papers Spain III.2 (British History Online), 'Spain: March 1527, 1-10' pp. 79-94, opened and searched for Soria and Lannoy: only Perez to Soria (item 32*) and a footnote on Lannoy, no Soria to Lannoy of 7 March; a printed Lannoy edition was not found.
prior_art.literature: Galende Diaz, Hispania 52/181 (1992) pp. 493-520 on Soria's cipher correspondence and Kolosova's 2017 thesis on Charles V's ciphers 1521-27 cover the RAH Salazar letters to the Emperor, not Modena Autografoteca Campori; no Cryptologia or HistoCrypt item on this letter found.

1562.key_check: Soria's own ciphers of the 1520s are held in the repo (targets/soria1523 keys A and B, targets/soria1527). The letter shares loop and cross signs with key B but its syllabic groups lab/leb/den differ from key B; no sign transcription or trial decode was run in this batch, so no key is claimed to read it.
1562.key_held: targets/soria1523 key A and key B, targets/soria1527 key: held in the repo, not applied to this letter in this batch (a key never blocks a lead).
1562.duplicates: known.py on 'Soria Lannoy', 'Lannoy', 'Autografoteca Campori' and the Lodovico id: no catalogue entry or target holds this letter; Soria entries are Charles V to Soria 1523/1524 (RAH) and Soria to Charles V (soria1527). CSP Spain does not calendar it.

894.unvetted: Cluster of four HHStA Tuerkei I items by four writers (6-1-26 Adorno 1545, 6-1-28 Mailath 1545, 7-2-23 Zapolya 1547, 3-1-11 news sheet 1533). AIS pages for 6-1-26 and 7-2-23 fetched 3 Nov 2026: both Reservatbestand ('Kein Zugang'), thumbnails only, 'teilweise chiffriert' / 'urspruenglich chiffriert, chiffriertes Schreiben liegt bei'; 6-1-28 and 3-1-11 are already leads 1760 and 1759. 6-1-26 is printed in Austro-Turcica 1541-1552 (Nehring, Munich 1995) pp. 47-48 and Petritsch Regesten no. 84, neither openable online, so a printed decipherment is unexcluded. Needs splitting per item (6-1-26 and 7-2-23 as own leads) and the Austro-Turcica volume.
